question: Under what condition does applying meditation after worship of the circle produce the stated effect in this practice?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the act of meditation.
The application of meditation is limited to a stated duration.
The practice links worship and sustained meditative application in sequence.
inference: Sustained meditative application follows worship of the circle for as long as the practice continues.
uncertainties: The precise scope of the temporal limit remains unspecified.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as that practice lasts.
